Shanghai metro topology data

Source: OpenStreetMap contributors, network relation 6799988
https://www.openstreetmap.org/relation/6799988
https://api.openstreetmap.org/api/0.6/relation/6799988.json
Retrieved: 2026-10-30 (UTC; 2026-10-31 in Korea)

The station coordinates and ordered route topology in metro-data.json and
metro-data.js are derived from OpenStreetMap and are distributed under the
Open Database License (ODbL) 1.0:
https://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/1-0/
Attribution: (c) OpenStreetMap contributors
https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright

The compact database is available as metro-data.json, in an open JSON format.
It includes the route relation IDs and source stop node IDs. The originating
OSM objects are also publicly accessible through the OSM API.

Changes from the original data:
- Condensed ordered stop nodes into station groups and directed route patterns.
- Added Korean travel labels where reviewed; other names remain in Chinese.
- Excluded Line 16 express/direct services and duplicate Line 1 short turns.
- Kept Line 4 circular closure, and same-name Line 2 / 17 National Exhibition
  and Convention Center stations separate. Source for separate station status:
  https://www.ciie.org/zbh/bqxwbd/20240930/45951.html
- Conservatively split Line 5 branch services at Dongchuan Road; passengers
  must follow the actual train destination and station announcements.
- Included the Huangpu River centreline, from OSM relation 19289628, to reject
  all walking access candidates and snapping offsets that cross the river.
  This deliberately excludes even possible bridge walks: routing tables do
  not expose ferry legs, and metro journeys can cross by rail instead.
  https://www.openstreetmap.org/relation/19289628

The database describes connectivity, not a timetable. Service outages,
first/last trains, platform/exit choices, accessibility, fares, live departures
and train occupancy are not included. Route times and access walking distances
are local estimates, not observations or operator guarantees. Approximate
station-to-station geometry is deliberately not drawn as a railway alignment.

This data license applies to the derived database. It does not change the
license of unrelated application source code.
